anomalies.description: A group of individuals, some wearing yellow vests, are engaged in chaotic movement amid heavy smoke or tear gas in an urban setting; they appear to be clashing with or retreating from unseen forces near a metal barrier, consistent with riot conditions.; A chaotic, smoke-filled street scene with a large group of people in yellow vests actively engaging in violent collective action—including dragging, beating, and surrounding individuals—consistent with violent unrest rather than peaceful protest.

A group of individuals in yellow vests are engaged in sustained physical combat with one or more persons on the ground; multiple participants are seen grabbing, pulling, and striking while surrounding the individual(s) who appear restrained or incapacitated.
One or more individuals are lying on the ground while being repeatedly struck, kicked, and held down by a group of people in yellow vests, indicating a helpless victim subjected to ongoing assault.
A person is lying on the ground while multiple others in yellow vests surround and physically assault them, including kicking and stomping, indicating a helpless victim being attacked.
A group of individuals in yellow vests are engaged in mutual physical combat around a person on the ground; multiple participants are actively pulling, pushing, and striking in a chaotic cluster.

A large group of people in yellow vests engages in sustained violent unrest: clashing with unseen forces (implied by smoke, barriers, and defensive postures), throwing objects (e.g., frame f4 shows an object mid-air), and collectively confronting authority near a barricade amid heavy smoke and debris-strewn pavement.

A large group of individuals, many wearing yellow vests, are engaged in chaotic movement amid heavy smoke or tear gas on a wet paved surface; some appear to be pushing against barriers or each other, with debris scattered on the ground and people running or retreating. The scene shows collective violent unrest, including physical clashes and dispersal under crowd-control conditions.; A group of individuals, many wearing yellow vests, are engaged in chaotic movement amid heavy smoke or tear gas on a wet paved area (likely a bridge or plaza). People are running, throwing objects, and interacting aggressively; some appear to be confronting or evading others. Debris is visible on the ground, and the environment suggests violent unrest rather than a peaceful gathering.

In the central cluster (frames f0–f7), multiple individuals are seen grappling, shoving, and engaging in close physical contact—some appear to be pulling or restraining others, consistent with mutual physical combat rather than coordinated movement or dispersal alone.

At approximately 26.0–27.5 seconds, two individuals (one in a yellow vest, one in dark clothing) engage in direct physical confrontation: the person in yellow appears to throw or swing an object while lunging toward the other, who is recoiling or dodging near a railing. This constitutes mutual or attempted physical combat.

A crowd of people surrounds two overturned and damaged police vans (marked 'Politie') on a city street; smoke rises from the vehicles, and individuals are seen throwing objects, moving aggressively, and filming the scene. The presence of multiple persons in high-visibility vests (likely police) and the deliberate overturning of official vehicles indicate collective violent unrest.

Two white police vans are lying on their sides in the middle of a street, with visible damage (shattered windows, dented bodies), smoke emanating from them, and debris scattered around. This is consistent with a severe vehicular incident involving overturning and impact, though the cause (e.g., collision vs. deliberate overturning) is not visually determinable beyond the state of the vehicles.

A crowd of individuals, some wearing helmets, masks, and dark clothing, surrounds the overturned police vehicle; several people are filming, and red smoke (likely from a flare or smoke grenade) is visible near the overturned van in later frames (e.g., f5–f15). Police officers in high-visibility vests are present but appear outnumbered and passive. The context suggests collective unrest involving property damage and confrontation with authorities.

A white Dutch police van is overturned on its side in the middle of a city street, with visible damage to its windows and body; another police van is parked nearby with smoke or vapor emitting from its front area. The scene remains static across all frames, indicating the accident has already occurred and is being observed by onlookers.

A large group of people wearing yellow vests are engaged in collective unrest in an urban street setting, with visible smoke (likely from tear gas or flares) and pyrotechnic sparks (e.g., at f3, f4), indicating violent confrontation or dispersal efforts. The crowd is dense, moving dynamically, and some individuals appear to be throwing objects or reacting to irritants. The Eiffel Tower is visible in the background (f6–f8), confirming location as Paris; this aligns with known Yellow Vest protests involving riotous behavior.

At f3 (137.5 s), a sudden burst of bright red sparks radiates outward in a radial pattern, consistent with a small pyrotechnic explosion (e.g., a flare or firework detonation). The interaction is mutual and dynamic, with shifting positions and forceful contact consistent with fighting.

The crowd surges, pushes, and appears to be confronting individuals near the car; the density, movement, and coordinated pressure suggest violent unrest beyond a simple scuffle.
